messages:
kai: quick mobile UX review for console nav — on small phones the left rail is making the main table super cramped. option A: overlay drawer under 480px. option B: mini-icons with long-press labels. thoughts?

emily: overlay drawer feels simpler for discoverability. mini icons could work on tablets but not phones.

omar: agree overlay for phones. also noticed tables are horizontally scrolling and action buttons disappear. maybe move low-priority columns into an expandable 'summary' inside each row.

soph: expansion pattern is good but add explicit aria-expanded and visible focus styles. also copy: change expand label from 'Details' to 'More' on mobile to reduce width.

kai: noted. propose breakpoint at 480 for overlay and 640 for mini-mode. CSS proto: `@media (max-width:480px){ .sidebar{position:fixed;left:0;transform:translateX(-100%);} .sidebar.open{transform:translateX(0);} }`

emily: small touch target reminder: FAB + toggles need >=48px touch. avoid putting FAB over table rows; shift FAB up when a row is expanded.

omar: copy nit: topbar label 'Routes & Models' is long — shorten to 'Routes' and show context pill when needed.

a11y-bot: scan results: contrast low on mini-icon labels in dark mode, missing aria-controls on sidebar toggle. checklist: [ ] contrast>=4.5, [ ] aria-expanded, [ ] 48px targets, [ ] focus return on drawer close.

soph: I'll pair with Omar on a11y tests tomorrow 9am PT. Kai: can you update figma with overlay + row-summary patterns?

kai: will do, posting prototype later today. :thumbsup:
